items.title: Jackie Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: He is a first call drummer for jazz recordings and appears with Dizzy Gillespie on Milt Hinton’s “Old Man Time.”

ctx.x: And when you look at some of these great artists like Milt Hinton and so forth — it must be such a thrill to play—
Yes. Milt has to be in every home there is, and so justifiably so. He is just such a great artist and human being. He’s just wonderful.
Has recording, the process of it, changed significantly over the years, since you started recording? The actual studio presence?
